# hibira_livechat_business_hours (Resource)

The business hours of a [Hibira Live Chat](https://chat.hibira.io) workspace: outside them the widget shows the away message and asks for an email instead of promising a quick answer. A workspace has one set; destroying the resource turns business hours off. Business hours are on the Team and Business plans. Import with the workspace's ID. Uses the provider's API token, which needs write access (and delete access to remove things) and an owner or admin of the workspace as its owner; the workspace's plan must include the API (Team and up). Needs a Hibira server with API tokens on Live Chat (pusher-server#898).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hibira_livechat_business_hours" "main" {
  workspace_id = "ws_0123456789abcdef"
  time_zone    = "Asia/Taipei"

  days = {
    monday    = { from = "09:00", to = "18:00" }
    tuesday   = { from = "09:00", to = "18:00" }
    wednesday = { from = "09:00", to = "18:00" }
    thursday  = { from = "09:00", to = "18:00" }
    friday    = { from = "09:00", to = "17:00" }
  }

  closed_dates = ["2026-12-25", "2027-01-01"]
  away_message = "We're away right now. Leave your email and we'll answer in the morning."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `days` (Attributes Map) Opening hours by weekday (`monday` … `sunday`); a day left out is closed. Times are `HH:MM`, `to` may be `24:00`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--days))
- `workspace_id` (String) The Live Chat workspace's ID (`ws_...`, in Live Chat's Settings, or `GET /v1/workspaces`). Changing it makes a new one there.

### Optional

- `away_message` (String) Shown in the widget outside business hours, at most 300 characters. Empty (default): Live Chat's own.
- `closed_dates` (Set of String) Holidays and other closed days, as `YYYY-MM-DD` in `time_zone`; at most 60.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the hours apply. Defaults to `true`.
- `time_zone` (String) An IANA time zone, such as `Asia/Taipei`. Defaults to `UTC`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The workspace's ID.

<a id="nestedatt--days"></a>
### Nested Schema for `days`

Required:

- `from` (String) Opens at, such as `09:00`.
- `to` (String) Closes at, such as `18:00`; after `from`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hibira_livechat_business_hours.main ws_0123456789abcdef
```
